title: Refining Language Models with Compositional Explanations
reasoning: The paper focuses on a machine learning framework (REMOTE) for refining language models to mitigate spurious correlations and bias in text classification tasks like hate speech detection. While it evaluates fairness using established metrics (FPRD) and identifies religious groups as one of many identity categories for monitoring bias, it is primarily a technical work on model refinement rather than a study or benchmark of religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
